name: UK Community Tree Planting Programme
summary: Pays for community woodland and hedge planting of native trees on publicly accessible land in the UK, with trees, advice and two years of aftercare payments.

amount.note: Maximum price per tree inclusive of protection and mulch; plus two maintenance grants of £0.10 per tree

status.quote: Your completed application can be submitted anytime from 29th June onwards.

deadline.quote: There is a final application deadline of Friday 11th December 2026.

administered_by.quote: ITF's priorities for this round of the UK Community Tree Planting Programme

applicant_types.quote: Your organisation must be community-based and/or have a social benefit e.g. a school, community group, social enterprise, non-governmental organisation, parish council, etc.

access.quote: To get started, please login or register onto your grant application portal here: https://internationaltreefoundation.grantplatform.com/

window.quote: There is a final application deadline of Friday 11th December 2026.

amount.quote: Projects to range from 100 - 10,000 trees planted per year, with a maximum price equivalent to £2.15/tree (inclusive of tree protection and mulch). In addition, these projects also receive two maintenance grants equivalent to £0.10/tree, both in the first and second summers after planting.
